displayPattern: 7-segment display on an American Standard S9V2 two-stage variable-speed furnace: E09
meaning: Open inducer limit switch, or open condensate pressure switch.
diySteps: The heating sequence will not start the inducer until the condensate pressure switch and the inducer limit switch are proved closed
Technician: check the inducer limit and the condensate pressure switch, including the condensate drain path those switches watch
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. E09 stops the heating cycle before ignition. A frozen or blocked condensate line is a technician diagnosis on this control.
